dedupe_keys.name: digiwave predictive uv dose control for wastewater disinfection

description: Wolfgang Seis at Kompetenzzentrum Wasser Berlin publishes DigiWave for predictive ultraviolet dosing at a wastewater-treatment plant. Zenodo archives R code, anonymised plant data and fitted models under MIT. The linked README describes prediction of incoming E. coli from sensor signals, a UV dose-response relation and calculation of the minimum dose meeting a discharge limit. Reproducible stages compare that policy with constant dosing and estimate energy savings. The model can support disinfection-control simulations at plants with comparable measurements. No related catalogue record explicitly covers DigiWave. Coverage is one anonymised effluent UV stage, not all wastewater plants. A limitation is that sensor features were affine-transformed with withheld coefficients; absolute raw units and retraining inputs cannot be recovered from this public release. Cleaning and fitting stages require confidential data, while later stages run from sanitized artifacts. The code was not downloaded or run, and neither pathogen reduction nor energy saving was independently validated.
